tags.name: Extractions
tags.description: Owner-scoped contract findings, evidence and evaluation metrics

modelQuote.description: Original model quote, which may differ from the source quote for approximate matches; empty for legacy evidence.

matchScore.description: Multiset word Dice overlap; threshold 0.5 inclusive. Exact matches score 1.

values.description: Versioned allowed fields are specified by the extraction target; ISO dates, decimal amounts/durations and explicit currency/unit.

modelReportedOutcomes.description: Diagnostic model classifications, including rejected outputs; never validated findings.

items.description: Prompt ID/subject, step/model/provider identifiers, nullable provider revision, prompt/schema hashes, input/output/total/accumulated token counters, API attempts, processing status and persistence timestamps.

valueSchema.description: OpenAPI 3.0 Schema Object for this definition version; null when unsupported.

EffectiveDateValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for agreement-effective-date, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

ExpirationValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for agreement-expiration, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

RenewalValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for renewal-term, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

NonRenewalNoticeValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for non-renewal-notice, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

NonCompeteValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for non-compete, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

ConvenienceTerminationValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for termination-convenience, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

LiabilityCapValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for liability-cap, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

UncappedLiabilityValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for uncapped-liability, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

AuditRightsValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for audit-rights, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.

InsuranceObligationsValuesV1.description: Optional explicit values for insurance-obligations, schemaVersion 1. Missing values mean unknown. Each populated value requires evidence.
